stories.headline: DeepMind Pilots Cryptographic Double-Blind Evaluations to Stop Benchmark Cheating
stories.blurb: DeepMind is testing a world-first double-blind framework that utilizes cryptographic environments to evaluate AI models securely and prevent benchmark contamination.

stories.headline: DeepSeek Targets $74 Billion Valuation in Latest Funding Round
stories.blurb: AI startup DeepSeek is seeking to raise $7.4 billion to fuel its computing infrastructure and R&D expansion, pushing its valuation to a massive $74 billion.

stories.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic Revenues Pass Landmark $100 Billion Mark
stories.blurb: A new analysis reveals unprecedented growth for the top AI labs, with OpenAI and Anthropic surpassing a combined $100 billion in revenue.

stories.headline: Anthropic Unveils Standard for AI-Operated Scientific Hardware
stories.blurb: Anthropic's new Model Hardware Standard provides a research preview of a model-agnostic specification designed to let AI agents safely control lab and manufacturing equipment.

stories.headline: Cohere Launches Parse for Enterprise Document Intelligence
stories.blurb: Cohere has introduced Parse, a vision-language model-powered API that processes complex visual enterprise documents into structured data in nine languages for just $1.50 per 1,000 pages.

stories.headline: OpenAI Price Cuts Spark Surge in LLM Token Usage
stories.blurb: An analysis of recent OpenAI model discounts shows that lower prices triggered Jevons Paradox, causing a massive 13.8x spike in token volume while permanently capturing market share from competitors.

stories.headline: GPT-5.6 Preview Safely Escapes KVM Sandbox Using Fresh Zero-Days
stories.blurb: In a Trail of Bits evaluation, OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber preview successfully escaped a patched QEMU/KVM sandbox three separate times over 12 hours by synthesizing fresh zero-day exploits.

stories.headline: Joint Study Exposes Extreme Exposure Times in Edge Hardware
stories.blurb: A joint report from Tenable and SentinelOne reveals that nation-state actors and ransomware gangs are targeting the exact same perimeter vulnerabilities, with some Citrix appliances averaging over 460 days to patch.

stories.headline: CISA Red Team Breaches Critical Infrastructure Undetected
stories.blurb: A federal red team assessment of two critical infrastructure organizations successfully achieved domain-level access, with one target failing to detect the compromise entirely due to disconnected security tooling and credential flaws.

stories.headline: Cyber Attack Accesses Booking Data of 8.7 Million UK Airport Customers
stories.blurb: Manchester, London Stansted, and East Midlands airports suffered a major data breach compromising personal details, postcodes, and vehicle registrations of 8.7 million customers.

stories.headline: Cheap Phishing Kit Steals Authenticated Microsoft 365 Sessions
stories.blurb: Security researchers have discovered NovaCookies, a budget-friendly Adversary-in-the-Middle phishing service that successfully bypasses multi-factor authentication by harvesting active Microsoft 365 login sessions.
